name: El Tajin, Pre-Hispanic City
description: El Tajín is an ancient city in the lush Gulf Coast state of Veracruz, Mexico, named for the Totonac rain god. Its signature monument, the Pyramid of the Niches, is a stepped tower lined with rows of recessed openings. The site also holds palaces and around 20 ballcourts, many decorated with carved reliefs. European authorities only learned of it in 1785.
